title: Angles & the Pythagorean Theorem
description: Angle facts, parallel lines, triangle angles, and Pythagorean calculations.

questions.q: Angles on a straight line add up to:
questions.explanation: Adjacent angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.

questions.q: Angles around a point add up to:
questions.explanation: A full turn around a point is $360^\circ$.

questions.q: The angles in a triangle add up to:
questions.explanation: The interior angles of a triangle sum to $180^\circ$.

questions.q: Find the third angle of a triangle with angles $50^\circ$ and $60^\circ$.
A right triangle has shorter sides $6$ cm and $8$ cm. Find the hypotenuse.
A right triangle has hypotenuse $13$ cm and one side $5$ cm. Find the other side.
Which triple forms a right-angled triangle?
Vertically opposite angles are:
Complementary angles add up to:
Supplementary angles add up to:
Find the supplement of $115^\circ$.
Find the complement of $38^\circ$.
Each angle of an equilateral triangle is:
questions.explanation: An equilateral triangle has three equal angles, each $180/3=60^\circ$.

questions.q: The base angles of an isosceles triangle are:
questions.explanation: An isosceles triangle has equal base angles.

questions.q: A square has diagonal $10$ cm. Find its side length.
A ladder $15$ m long reaches a point $12$ m up a wall. How far is its foot from the wall?
If two parallel lines are cut by a transversal, corresponding angles are:
questions.explanation: Corresponding angles are equal for parallel lines.

questions.q: Alternate interior angles between parallel lines are:
questions.explanation: Alternate interior angles are equal when the lines are parallel.

questions.q: Interior angles on the same side of a transversal add up to:
questions.explanation: Co-interior angles between parallel lines are supplementary.

questions.q: Find $x$ if $x+35^\circ=90^\circ$.
Find $x$ if $2x+40^\circ=180^\circ$.
The exterior angle of a triangle equals:
options: sum of the two opposite interior angles
sum of all three interior angles
questions.explanation: An exterior angle equals the sum of the two remote interior angles.

questions.q: A triangle has sides $7,24,25$. What type is it?
Find the diagonal of a rectangle $9$ cm by $12$ cm.
If an angle is $x$ and its vertically opposite angle is $78^\circ$, find $x$.
A triangle has angles $x,2x,3x$. Find $x$.
Which angle is obtuse?
questions.explanation: An obtuse angle is greater than $90^\circ$ and less than $180^\circ$.

questions.q: Which angle is reflex?
questions.explanation: A reflex angle is greater than $180^\circ$ and less than $360^\circ$.

questions.q: Find the length of the hypotenuse when the legs are $9$ and $40$.
Find the missing leg if the hypotenuse is $10$ and one leg is $8$.
A rhombus has perpendicular diagonals $6$ cm and $8$ cm. Find the side length.
questions.explanation: Half-diagonals are $3$ and $4$, so the side is $\sqrt{3^2+4^2}=5$ cm.

questions.q: The angle sum of a quadrilateral is:
questions.explanation: A quadrilateral can be split into two triangles, so its angle sum is $360^\circ$.

questions.q: Find one angle of a regular hexagon.
questions.explanation: Interior angle of a regular $n$-gon is $(n-2)180/n$. For $6$, it is $120^\circ$.

questions.q: The exterior angle of a regular pentagon is:
If a bearing is $090^\circ$, the direction is:
questions.explanation: A bearing of $090^\circ$ points due East.

questions.q: If $a^2+b^2<c^2$ for the longest side $c$, the triangle is:
questions.explanation: When the square of the longest side is greater than the sum of the other squares, the triangle is obtuse.

questions.q: Find the distance between $(0,0)$ and $(6,8)$.
A pole casts a shadow $5$ m long. The top of the pole is $13$ m from the tip of the shadow. Find the pole height.
If two angles are supplementary and one is $4$ times the other, find the smaller angle.
questions.explanation: Let the smaller angle be $x$. Then $x+4x=180$, so $x=36^\circ$.

questions.q: The longest side of a right triangle is called the:
questions.explanation: The side opposite the right angle is the hypotenuse.
